
# For potential participants

Please reach out if you are interested in participating in research!

UC Merced students interested in participating can find out more about ongoing studies in the lab by checking out our lab's studies on [SONA](https://ucmerced.sona-systems.com/default.aspx?logout=Y).

We are also recruiting individuals from the community, especially individuals who are in their 60s and older. You can fill out this brief form to indicate that you are interested in particating and we will reach out to you soon: [https://redcap.link/LInC.Lab](https://redcap.link/LInC.Lab)

# For prospective students or postdocs

If you are interested in joining the lab as a researcher, please reach out to [Rachel Ryskin](https://raryskin.github.io/) directly.
